description: This source file defines a Java interface for building AccessControlList objects, providing a fluent API for manipulation and construction of access control entries related to Eclipse Ditto model components.

classes.name: AccessControlListBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder for a {@link AccessControlList} with a fluent API, allowing setting, removing, and building access control entries.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the given AclEntry in the builder, replacing any existing entry with the same authorization subject.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple AclEntries in the builder, replacing entries with the same authorization subjects.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific AclEntry or the entry with the specified AuthorizationSubject from the builder.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all entries from the builder that have the same authorization subjects as those in the provided Iterable.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable AccessControlList containing the entries set in this builder.
